representative_timing_review.review_scope: Existing evidence only; no hardware run, model change or timing/amplitude fit.
representative_timing_review.selection: For width diagnostics only: retain falling threshold crossings within 15ns of the unique 400mV descending crossing, upper before/lower after. Excludes earlier HOLD noise crossings; no alignment is altered.
representative_timing_review.amplitude_shape_observation: Raw 5ns medians are 595.816mV before the fast edge; transient minimum individual sample113.808mV and 5ns median127.197mV, followed by about200.837mV plateau. This transient remains an observed waveform feature regardless of global time-origin choice; cause unassigned.
representative_timing_review.conclusion: Command metadata, compiler advance and model timing are internally consistent; no demonstrated double-counted startup or next-SET cancellation. Existing fixed-anchor residual is real under that convention, but ~41ns displacement lies inside the54.335ns first-edge candidate ambiguity. This evidence alone cannot separate RTL latency from global alignment/analog transfer/noise effects.
